title: Show tick glosses in pane titles, alerts and status
description:
ticks is adding an optional 'gloss' field — a few-word label to show next to a tick id (upstream: ticks zs7 (tick gloss field)). ticfac's own surfaces show bare ids today: herdr pane titles are 'id · role · status' (internal/herd/paint Title), and ticfac status, the event feed and Telegram alerts name ticks by id only.

Blocked on upstream: this cannot start until ticks zs7 ships and ticfac's pinned contract bundle is re-cut to include the field (CONTRACTS.md: sync to a ticks commit carrying it). Cross-repo, so the dependency is stated here rather than as blocked_by.

Change: internal/tk reads gloss; every human-facing surface renders 'id (gloss)', falling back to the title cut to the same cap when gloss is empty or the field is absent; --json outputs carry gloss as its own field, never baked into the id.
acceptance_criteria: [A1] contracts.pin.json points at a ticks commit whose tk-json manifest has gloss, and contracts check passes. [A2] herdr pane titles, ticfac status (human view) and the phone alerts render id (gloss); a test covers both gloss-present and empty-gloss fallback. [A3] --json outputs carry gloss as a separate field. [A4] make test is green.
closed_reason: Pin: ticks@3c433914 (bundle 6.3.0, both pins), contracts check + verify-upstream ok. herdr pane titles and ticfac status (follow + one-shot) name ticks 'id (label)' via tk.Label (gloss, else title cut to 40); a tracker that cannot be read costs only the labels. herd paint --json badges carry 'label'. Not done here: phone alerts do not exist yet (noted on i1r); status --json unchanged (it carries ids; a consumer reads labels from tk). Gate: make vet + make gate green, cloudflare typecheck + vitest 1453/1453.
